FR.name: France
FR.note: The outline includes the overseas departments — the shape in South America is French Guiana, an EU outermost region.

applies.evidence: Proclaimed by UN General Assembly resolution 217 A, Paris, 10 Dec 1948, "as a common standard of achievements for all peoples and all nations"; non-binding, no ratification process — recorded here on UN membership, not a treaty action.
France — Signature 30 Mar 2007, Ratification 18 Feb 2010

France: "EU Member State: since 1 January 1958" (european-union.europa.eu). Charter Article 51(1) (europarl.europa.eu/charter/pdf/text_en.pdf): "The provisions of this Charter are addressed to the institutions and bodies of the Union … and to the Member States only when they are implementing Union law."

"DIRECTIVE (EU) 2019/882 OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL of 17 April 2019 on the accessibility requirements for products and services" — "Member States shall adopt and publish, by 28 June 2022, the laws, regulations and administrative provisions necessary to comply with this Directive ... They shall apply those measures from 28 June 2025." (Art. 31) Binds France as an EU member state. (eur-lex.europa.eu, Official Journal of the EU)

"DIRECTIVE (EU) 2016/2102 OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL of 26 October 2016 on the accessibility of the websites and mobile applications of public sector bodies" — "Member States shall bring into force the laws, regulations and administrative provisions necessary to comply with this Directive by 23 September 2018." (Art. 12) Binds France as an EU member state. (eur-lex.europa.eu, Official Journal of the EU)
